reason: Commercial green chutneys inevitably reek of synthetic vinegar and preservatives, and waiting 2-3 days for courier delivery doesn't fit my morning routine.
objection: Why order online and wait 2 to 3 days when I can grab sauce from the local kirana or make it at home without artificial chemicals?
would_change_my_mind: 100% natural ingredients without vinegar, available right now at my neighbourhood kirana.
